mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_citation ( assistant_message_id, citation_id, document_id, document_version, document_title, document_type, source_locator, page_number, quote ) VALUES ( #{assistantMessageId}, #{citationId}, #{documentId}, #{documentVersion}, #{documentTitle}, #{documentType}, #{sourceLocator}, #{pageNumber}, #{quote} ) ON CONFLICT (assistant_message_id, citation_id) DO UPDATE SET document_id = EXCLUDED.document_id, document_version = EXCLUDED.document_version, document_title = EXCLUDED.document_title, document_type = EXCLUDED.document_type, source_locator = EXCLUDED.source_locator, page_number = EXCLUDED.page_number, quote = EXCLUDED.quote
mapper.select: SELECT citation.assistant_message_id, citation.citation_id, citation.document_id, citation.document_version, citation.document_title, citation.document_type, citation.source_locator, citation.page_number, citation.quote, citation.create_time, COALESCE( current_document.update_time = citation.document_version, FALSE ) AS available FROM chat_citation citation JOIN chat_message message ON message.id = citation.assistant_message_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_document current_document ON current_document.id = citation.document_id WHERE message.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY message.sequence_id, citation.citation_id
